text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, Mejiro Dober invited me along to 
accompany her on a shopping trip with 
Mejiro Ryan.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...Music? Coming from over there...

text_block_list.name: Show Staff
text_block_list.text:
Too bad! Taiki Shuttle scored 89 points! 
The luxury steak prize will have to wait 
for another day!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Nooo... I was planning to have a steak 
party with everyone using this prize, 
buuuut...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"Dober, please!! Won't you take on the 
karaoke challenge with me?!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Huh!? Me?

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Locals
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, is that girl taking the 
challenge next? Hehe, let's stay and watch 
until the next one!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ......No, wait. I want to help, but I'm—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Wait, Taiki. Do you mind if I go in 
your place?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Ryan...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"...Still, if I just keep relying on them 
like this..."

text_block_list.name: Show Staff
text_block_list.text:
Seeking our next challenger! Anyone want 
to try for a high score in karaoke~?
choice_data_list: Dober will take on the challenge!

I should just accept Ryan's kindness for 
now.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Eeeek?! P-Please wait! Um, there are way 
too many people watching—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...! No, Ryan. I want to try. I want to 
take on the challenge myself.

text_block_list.name: Show Staff
text_block_list.text: Now then, next challenger, step right up!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...I'm Mejiro Dober. I'll be singing 
"Youth is Waiting." My friend... sang it, 
too...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Ah-wawa, I wonder if Dober is going to be 
okay...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Music begins to play from the karaoke 
machine, and the people on the street turn 
to look at Mejiro Dober all at once.

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text:
Ah, look! It's Mejiro Dober!! I really 
love her singing voice, you know!

text_block_list.name: Passerby B
text_block_list.text:
I wonder what she's gonna sing? Whoa, do 
you think it's okay if I take a video?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
choice_data_list: Dober! This is a concert venue!
Dober! This is a live concert venue!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...A live performance.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Ah, exactly, Dober! You're an Umamusume 
who can truly convey your gratitude to the 
fans who cheer you on!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"Don't worry, you can do it! I guarantee 
it!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"...It all started from something 
trivial...! Meeting someone... and...!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: ...You're amazing, Dober.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Your courage is growing day by day, isn't 
it? ...I need to learn from your example.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Singing karaoke out in the city. It might 
seem like a small thing, but for Mejiro 
Dober, it was surely a massive step 
forward.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And she brilliantly scored over 90 points, 
so we all had a party with the steak 
prize, along with Taiki Shuttle.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: (I knew it, this is so embarrassing...!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"...It all starts from something trivial♪ 
Meeting someone... perhaps?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Huh... Ryan, Trainer...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
...Just now, you took a very courageous 
step forward. That in itself is truly 
wonderful.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
But sometimes you can't muster up courage 
alone. So when that happens... try doing 
it together. Let's gradually get you used 
to being brave.
choice_data_list:
...Would it be alright if everyone sang 
the rest together?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: …………Both of you……!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Listen, the next melody is starting! My 
heart is pounding with excitement♪ This 
brand-new feeling... ready, set, go!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...I just wanted... to call it 'youth'...! 
(seishun)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Ngh! We who have nothing to our name~♪

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text:
...I realized that someday, I'll be able 
to grasp anything!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Unfortunately, the final score didn't 
reach 90 points. However, it became a day 
where we gained something far greater than 
that.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer, were you listening?
choice_data_list:
Sorry, you looked like you were really 
struggling to decide.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"Huh, Trainer!? ...Did I say that out 
loud?"
choice_data_list:
Sorry, you looked like you were really 
struggling to decide.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
choice_data_list:
Still, once you're mentally ready, let's 
take on the challenge next time.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
? Preparations? What's up? What are you 
talking about?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"...Sorry, it's nothing. I just don't have 
the courage."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
...I don't know what she's preparing for, 
but Dober is a girl who can find her 
courage when it counts.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
So once you're all ready, give it 
everything you've got. I'll be cheering 
for you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Ryan...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you.
